name: Mommy's Boy
source:
When Lauren reported her colleague, Vicki, for misappropriating company funds she didn’t expect to be the target of a very unusual retaliation.

“Back the fuck off, or I’ll fuck your son.”

Lauren never took this threat seriously… until Vicki began her insidious campaign to slowly seduce and corrupt her precious boy.

Lauren now finds herself having to make an impossible choice. Will she watch her son slowly get seduced and stolen away, or will she compete against Vicki in a twisted game of corruption and seduction?

[From the [url=https://dreambiggame.com/mommys-boy/]official site[/url]]
